checks.name: a file backs what it said it delivered

must.item: Same sneaker in original side view, fully inside frame
must.why: Side view preserved and fully in frame; slight shape redraw.
Stitching, laces, perforated sole dots all visible.

must.item: Grey floor and clutter replaced by seamless white
must.why: Background is white and clutter is gone, but the shadow is dark and grey-ish.

must.item: Soft shadow without visible floor boundary
must.why: Shadow is a dark, hard-ish blob offset to the left and below, with a visible dark smudge at the heel and a gradient halo; looks unnatural.

faults.what: Shadow is heavy, dark and uneven, extending left of the heel with a patchy gray cloud; not a soft clean contact shadow
Shoe was slightly regenerated: toe is a bit less rounded, the left edge of the shoe looks greyish and a faint grey cast appears on the upper
Image appears slightly blurry/soft at the edges

summary: The sneaker is cleanly isolated on white in the original side view, but the shadow is dark and patchy and the shoe is subtly redrawn, so it needs a retouch.
